<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_illu2_illumio.IllumioDeletionHandler</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>IllumioDeletionHandler</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var IllumioDeletionHandler = Class.create();
IllumioDeletionHandler.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {

    prepareDeletion: function() {
        var configSysId = this.getParameter('sysparm_config_sys_id');

        var result = {
            success: false,
            message: ''
        };

        try {
            if (gs.nil(configSysId)) {
                result.message = 'PCE Configuration sys_id is required.';
                return JSON.stringify(result);
            }

            var utils = new IllumioUtils();
            var payload = utils.prepareDeletionPayload(configSysId);

            result.success = payload.success;
            result.message = payload.message;
            result.cancelJob = payload.cancelJob || false;
            result.thresholdExceeded = payload.thresholdExceeded || false;
            result.deletionCount = payload.deletionCount || 0;
            result.unpairCount = payload.unpairCount || 0;
            result.skippedCount = payload.skippedCount || 0;
        } catch (ex) {
            gs.error('[IllumioDeletionHandler] Exception in prepareDeletion: ' + ex);
            result.message = 'Exception occurred: ' + ex;
        }

        return JSON.stringify(result);
    },

    type: 'IllumioDeletionHandler'

});
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-31 12:46:17</sys_created_on><sys_id>5a9591abc39e0f1050bffa0ed40131a1</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>IllumioDeletionHandler</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Illumio" source="x_illu2_illumio">15314f1ddb882700dc9fabc5ca961943</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Illumio">15314f1ddb882700dc9fabc5ca961943</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_5a9591abc39e0f1050bffa0ed40131a1</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-07-31 12:46:17</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
